title: Zwischenbericht Heading Hierarchy From Part Down
description: Restructure mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/zwischenbericht.tex so the document's real heading hierarchy starts at \part and moves gradually down through \section, \subsection, \subsubsection, \paragraph — instead of starting at \section as it does today. Concretely: Ergebnisse/Projektstand/Mittelverwendung/Ergebnisverwertung (currently \section) become \part; their current \subsection children become \section; current \subsubsection children (AP-Erfahrung/AP-Plattform/AP-Tool/AP-Validierung, Leibniz Universität Hannover, etc.) become \subsection; the current top-level (non-SemioNest-nested) \paragraph headings (Recherche, Interviews, User Stories, Generatoren, etc.) become \subsubsection. \paragraph headings that are already nested inside \begin{SemioNest} environments stay \paragraph unchanged (that's the existing deepest real tier; SemioNest's own recursive nesting mechanism handles anything visually deeper, which is out of scope here — that's owned by the open PRINT-HEADING-TIER-RESTYLE-PART-THROUGH-NESTED-PARAGRAPH ticket that restyles the sty chip colors). Use \counterwithin{section}{part} so \thesection renders as part.section (e.g. still 1.1, 1.2, ...) which keeps every existing dotted-number cross-reference in the prose (the manually-typed "(Abschnitt~1.2.3.3)"-style refs and "Kapitel~3") numerically identical after the shift — only "Kapitel~3" needs to become "Teil~3" since there is no \chapter in this scrartcl-based class. The appendix \section{Verzeichnisse} becomes \part{Verzeichnisse} too, for hierarchy consistency. Verify secnumdepth=4 is still sufficient (it is, since the deepest real command used stays \paragraph). Build with bun ./📜️script.ts build (or the print nx target) and visually confirm the TOC and heading numbers render as expected in a rendered PDF page.
summary: Shifted the zwischenbericht's real heading hierarchy so it starts at \part and cascades down: Ergebnisse/Projektstand/Mittelverwendung/Ergebnisverwertung (and the appendix Verzeichnisse) became \part; their \subsection children became \section; \subsubsection children (AP-Erfahrung/AP-Plattform/AP-Tool/AP-Validierung, Leibniz Universität Hannover, etc.) became \subsection; and the top-level (non-SemioNest-nested) \paragraph headings (Recherche, Interviews, User Stories, Generatoren, etc.) became \subsubsection. \paragraph headings already nested inside \begin{SemioNest} blocks were left unchanged, since that's the existing deepest real tier and SemioNest's own recursive nesting handles anything visually deeper (out of scope — owned by the separate PRINT-HEADING-TIER-RESTYLE-PART-THROUGH-NESTED-PARAGRAPH ticket). Added \counterwithin{section}{part} and \renewcommand{\thepart}{\arabic{part}} so \thesection still renders as part.section (e.g. 1.1, 1.2.3.3) — this keeps every existing manually-typed dotted cross-reference in the prose numerically identical to before the shift; verified this by rebuilding and diffing the TOC/body page numbers against the old ones. Only "Kapitel~3" needed a manual wording fix to "Teil~3" since this scrartcl-based class has no \chapter. secnumdepth=4 remains sufficient (deepest real command is still \paragraph). Built light+dark PDFs with bun ./📜️script.ts build (via nx, --skip-nx-cache to bypass a stale cache that was masking the fix) and visually confirmed the TOC and a body page (Teil 1 / Ergebnisse → Forschungsfragen und Vorgehen chip → Arbeitspakete → AP-Erfahrung → Recherche) render with sensible cascading chip colors, and confirmed both light and dark builds compile with zero errors/undefined-control-sequence warnings.
